history.summary: A near-new (2026/27 TOP) 99-yr leasehold 4BR at Sceneca Residence (D16), 1,518 sqft at $3.1M / $2,042 psf, with direct sheltered access to Tanah Merah MRT (50m). Asking sits at the bottom of the current $2,042–$2,657 psf range and just under the $2,065 unit median, on a deep 269-txn base — a genuinely well-priced, MRT-integrated unit. The $3.1M quantum on a 4BR is the main constraint.
history.rating_rationale: $2,042 psf is the floor of Sceneca's current transacting range (verified ~$2,042–$2,657, recent avg ~$2,044) and ~1% below the $2,065 unit median — attractive entry for a brand-new, directly MRT-connected unit. 50m to Tanah Merah EWL (one stop to Expo/DTL interchange) is a top-tier connectivity catalyst, and the 269-txn base gives real liquidity. Tempered by $3.1M quantum (above the deepest band, 4BR niche) and new-launch appreciation not yet resale-proven.
red_flags: $3.1M quantum on a 4BR thins the buyer pool above the deep-liquidity band
New-launch bias — appreciation not yet resale-validated
99-yr leasehold at a premium absolute price
4BR is only ~9% of the development — niche segment
catalysts: 50m sheltered direct access to Tanah Merah EWL MRT — one stop to Expo/DTL interchange
Asking at the bottom of the project's current PSF range, ~1% below unit median
D16 Bedok/Upper East Coast — TEL Bayshore precinct and East Coast transformation
Deep 269-txn liquidity base for a new project
